segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including one who had previously damaged her barrier with a stronger BHA exfoliant, broadly report no burning or irritation and describe visible texture improvement.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the pads clear their pores and smooth rough patches without stripping or over-drying their skin, sometimes needing a moisturizer afterward or a slower adjustment period.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one with sensitive combination skin who struggled to find non-breakout products, report clearer, more balanced skin after consistent use.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin report the pads help manage excess oil and breakouts, particularly around the chin and nose, without the burning some other exfoliating pads cause them.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including some with dry skin, report the pads do not dry out or strip their skin despite containing exfoliating acids; a couple note mild dryness with excessive use, and one with dry skin needed a slower adjustment period.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers report reduced redness and no irritation, including one who specifically credits the alcohol-free formula for soothing redness.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer who had previously damaged her skin barrier with a stronger BHA exfoliant reports these pads caused no burning, irritation or purging.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers consistently report fewer breakouts and clearer pores with regular use, including a preteen whose breakouts cleared within a week and an adult-acne reviewer managing ongoing breakouts; no reviewer reports new breakouts from the pads.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers describe the pads as controlling excess oil without a greasy after-feel, including one who found them especially helpful during PMS-related oiliness; two reviewers note their skin felt greasier than expected after use.

extraits.texte: I received this free to give my honest review. As someone who has used witch hazel most of my life, I was really disappointed in the greasy feeling these pads left on my face. My pores did not feel minimized.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review.] I have sensitive, combination skin, and it's hard to find products that don't cause breakouts. After about a month of using the Thayers Pore Refining Pads, I noticed a big improvement in my skin's appearance. My face feels clean and refreshed, and I've since started buying more from the Thayers line. Highly recommend!

I have very sensitive combo skin and I have always been nervous to try any exfoliants ever since I destoryed my skin barrier previously from using pauls choice BHA. I started using these pads just 2-3 times a week until I worked my way up and now I use one every other night. Upon the first time using them I didn't have any burning or irriation. These pads didn't even make me purge or anything. My skin texture has improved so much, especially my closed comedones. My skin feels softer and my skintone has evened out overall as well. I will never stop using these pads they work soooo well and are a great price point. I'm really glad I found them and gave them a shot!

I admittedly impulse purchased this when it was on sale…but I will 100% be purchasing again at full price! I have had bumpy, dry skin in the creases of my nose for as long as i can remember and this fixed that right away. My makeup goes on so much smoother now. I have very dry, sensitive skin and this is just the right alount of exfoliation to not irritate.

extraits.titre: Great for acne and oily skin
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As a big fan of Thayers' other products, I know the brand has a great reputation for effective skin care with natural formulas, and was really excited to try these pore refining pads. The pads work really nicely for toning your skin after cleansing, without any sort of burning or dryness. As someone who gets acne and struggles with oiliness, I found these pads to be helpful managing my skin and reducing the look of pores, especially around my chin. Would recommend!
